Advances financial inclusion for millions of first-time banking users in Latin America.

overview.en: ING Bank developed a generative AI chatbot with McKinsey to offer customers immediate, tailored assistance while improving self-service capabilities. Launched in September 2023 as Europe's first-of-its-kind customer-facing gen AI pilot, the chatbot uses a multi-step retrieval pipeline with ING-specific guardrails. summary.en: Resistant AI builds Google Cloud-powered solutions to combat document fraud, expedite background checks, and speed up underwriting.
summary.zh: Resistant AI 以 Google Cloud 打造解決方案，打擊文件詐欺、加快背景審查並加速承銷流程。

overview.en: Resistant AI builds AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud to combat fraud in financial services documentation and workflows. Its Document Forensics product, built on Google Cloud Document AI, checks submitted documents over 500 ways for signs of tampering and detects patterns of document reuse and mass fraud attempts across accounts. The solution can expedite background checks, reduce fraud losses, and speed up underwriting and claims processing. Customer Payoneer reduced manual document fraud reviews to just 18% of intake, with agents agreeing with AI verdicts 99.2% of the time.
overview.zh: Resistant AI 在 Google Cloud 上建構 AI 驅動解決方案，打擊金融服務文件和工作流程中的詐欺。其以 Google Cloud Document AI 為基礎的 Document Forensics 產品，透過逾 500 種方式檢查提交的文件以發現篡改跡象，並偵測跨帳戶的文件重複使用模式和大規模詐欺企圖。該解決方案可加快背景審查、減少詐欺損失，並加速承銷和索賠處理流程。客戶 Payoneer 將人工文件詐欺審核比例降至僅 18%，客服代理對 AI 裁決的認同率達 99.2%。

en: Document Forensics checks documents 500+ ways for tampering signs using Google Cloud Document AI.
Detects patterns of document reuse, template farms, and mass fraud attempts across accounts.
Payoneer reduced manual document fraud reviews to just 18% of intake using Resistant AI.
Agents agreed with AI verdicts 99.2% of the time, confirming high accuracy.
Expedites KYC document verification including proof of address, bank statements, and ID cards.
zh: Document Forensics 運用 Google Cloud Document AI 透過逾 500 種方式檢查文件篡改跡象。
偵測跨帳戶的文件重複使用模式、範本農場和大規模詐欺企圖。
Payoneer 使用 Resistant AI 將人工文件詐欺審核比例降至僅 18%。
客服代理對 AI 裁決的認同率達 99.2%，確認了高準確度。
加速 KYC 文件核驗，包括地址證明、銀行帳單和身份證件。
